instruction: Italicize the text in the three textboxes on slide 1, in top-to-bottom order.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires italicizing all three textboxes on slide 1. Slide 1 has shapes at indices 0, 1, and 4. Evaluator checks italic status of all three shapes.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic logic issue in getter (pptx__035b6187.py:36-40): The getter checks if ANY run has italic=True and immediately sets is_italic=True, then breaks. This means it returns True even if only a single character or word is italic.
Instruction requires italicizing 'the text' in textboxes, which semantically means ALL text should be italic, not just some text.
The getter should verify that ALL runs in ALL paragraphs have italic=True, not just check if at least one run is italic.
This logic flaw means the evaluator would incorrectly pass if only partial text is italicized, failing to verify the complete requirement.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change getter logic from 'if any run is italic' to 'if all runs are italic': Instead of breaking when finding italic=True, check all runs and ensure ALL have italic=True (or italic is not False).
Modify lines 33-40 to: is_italic = True; for para in text_frame.paragraphs: for run in para.runs: if not run.font.italic: is_italic = False; break
Alternative approach: Count total runs vs italic runs, return True only if all runs are italic (handling None as non-italic).
Ensure edge case handling: empty text frames, runs with font.italic=None should be treated appropriately.
